summary: Full backend suite for GMA Landing API executed against the external preview URL. 21/21 tests passed covering health, auth (login/me/logout with cookie + bearer, wrong-pwd/unknown-email 401), blog public list+slug+404, blog admin auth-gate + create/update/delete + slug uniqueness (duplicate appends -2, slug only regenerates on title_en change), contact public submit (valid + invalid email 422), contact admin list/mark-read/delete, and MongoDB hygiene (no _id leaks, bcrypt $2b$ hash, unique indexes on users.email and blog_posts.slug).

minor.issue: Cookie flag secure=False in code — fine for preview but must be True in production (HTTPS). Not a test failure.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentials with wildcard origin; preview works because frontend routes through same ingress. Consider explicit origins for production.

action_items: For production deploy: set cookie secure=True and restrict CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend origin (wildcard + credentials is a browser-level rejection).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~460 lines — acceptable now but will grow; consider splitting into routers (auth/blog/contact) and seeds module as features expand.
login handler hardcodes secure=False; should be env-driven (COOKIE_SECURE).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is functionally broken for cross-origin browser credentialed requests; acceptable only because preview proxies same-origin.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; switch to lifespan context manager.
admin_update_blog regenerates slug only when title_en changes — good, verified by test. Edge case: if new slug exactly equals existing (same base_slug), loop is skipped correctly.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed created. Tests create/delete their own TEST_ posts and contact submissions; all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_gma_backend.py as regression suite. It depends on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var and optionally MONGO_URL/DB_NAME for hygiene checks. All tests are self-cleaning. Admin creds fixed in file — update if .env changes.
